How to Convert Your Rewards?

To convert your NBF Rewards points, log in to the NBF Direct mobile app or online banking platform. Navigate to the Rewards section, select your desired redemption option, such as gift cards, Etihad Guest Miles, or cashback and follow the on-screen instructions to complete the process. Redemptions are processed instantly, allowing you to enjoy your rewards without delay.
